name: Cable Y Raise
instructions: Set two pulleys at the lowest position. Cross the cables and hold the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left hand.
Stand in the middle of the two pulleys with a small bend in your knees and your hands crossed in front of your hips.
Keep your arms almost straight and raise your hands up and out above your head until your arms make a Y shape. Pull your shoulder blades down and back. Do not arch your lower back.
Lower your hands slowly along the same path to the start position, and repeat.
